name: Google One
verdict_reason: Immich is the best software in this index and $24/yr is the worst reason to run it. A photos server wants real RAM, real storage and real backups — run Immich for ownership and privacy, not to save two dollars a month.
what_you_lose: Google's durability — your photos now live on disks you must 3-2-1 yourself, and 'backup of the backup' is on you
Storage math: the Immich box + offsite copy costs more than $1.99/mo forever

what_broke: Images are ghcr.io-hosted — this pair's compose boot is verified by the CI runner
Immich requires its own pgvector-patched Postgres image; a vanilla postgres:16 will not do
